person_note: The controlling narrator is Katy, a story participant who narrates as “I.” Numerous event quotes expose that voice across grief, travel, relationships, memories, and later reflections, while the authorized publisher excerpt independently establishes the same voice in Chapter One. BookRags explicitly describes Katy’s first-person narration across her full character arc. Third-person references to Carol or other characters occur inside Katy’s narration, and second-person forms are generic advice or dialogue rather than a separate base strand. The main scope limitation is that the Tier A prose is an opening excerpt, but the distributed interior quote evidence and whole-book POV description agree, with no credible indication of alternating narration.
